name: KuCoin
tagline: Global crypto exchange API for market data, trading, and account management
description: KuCoin provides REST and WebSocket APIs for public market data and authenticated trading on a major global cryptocurrency exchange. Developers can access spot markets, futures, account balances, order management, and real-time market streams with broad altcoin coverage.

auth.details: API key, secret, and passphrase via KC-API-KEY, KC-API-SIGN, KC-API-TIMESTAMP, KC-API-PASSPHRASE, KC-API-KEY-VERSION headers; self-serve from account API management

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with exchange account; rate limits apply by endpoint/weight, not a separate paid API product

rate_limits: Resource-pool and VIP-tier based; each endpoint deducts a documented weight and quotas reset every 30 seconds. Global VIP0: Public 2,000/30s, Spot/Margin 4,000/30s, Futures 2,000/30s. Public pools are IP-based; private pools are UID-based.
use_cases: get ticker or order book for a KuCoin spot pair
place or cancel spot orders programmatically
list account balances and trade history
stream real-time trades and order book via WebSocket
